chart.$description: Chart: a plot with its axes, a legend and a tooltip. The marks take the design system's chart colors.

height.$description: The height with the title and the legend.

bar-width.$description: The thickest a bar gets: the rest of a band stays air.

bar-radius.$description: The corners at the end of a bar. It stays square at the baseline.

bar-gap.$description: The gap between bars side by side, and between the pieces of a stack.

marker-size.$description: The size of a dot on a line and of a point of a scatter chart.

marker-ring.$description: The ring in the color behind the chart that keeps a dot apart from what it crosses.

area-opacity.$description: How strong the fill under a line is.

bubble-min.$description: The radius of the smallest bubble.

bubble-max.$description: The radius of the largest bubble.

bubble-opacity.$description: How strong a bubble is, so those behind it show.

hit-size.$description: How far from a dot the pointer still reaches it.

tick-gap.$description: The room each mark of an axis wants.

tick-pad.$description: The distance from the plot to the labels of an axis.

grid-width.$description: The width of a grid line.

axis-width.$description: The width of an axis line.

crosshair-width.$description: The width of the line that follows the pointer.

active-opacity.$description: How strongly a bar under the pointer lifts.

loading-opacity.$description: How far the marks dim while new values load.

rise.$description: A step up of a waterfall, and a candle that closed higher; a rising candle is also hollow.

fall.$description: A step down of a waterfall, and a candle that closed lower.

connector.$description: The thin line that carries a waterfall from one step to the next.

wick-width.$description: The width of the wick of a candle, and of the lines of an OHLC bar.

scale-low.$description: The low end of a heat map that only rises.

scale-negative.$description: The end below zero of a heat map that crosses it.

cell-radius.$description: The corners of a cell of a heat map.

slice-lift.$description: How far a slice under the pointer comes out of its circle.

donut-hole.$description: The hole of a donut, as a share of its radius.

reference-width.$description: The width of a reference line.

reference-opacity.$description: How strong a reference band is.

brush-opacity.$description: How strong the band being dragged to zoom is.

selected-width.$description: The width of the ring around a chosen value.

root.$description: The chart as a whole: its text color and font.

head.$description: The row of the titles and the tools.

plot.$description: The plot: `focus` when the keyboard is on it.

crosshair.$description: The line that follows the pointer.

active-bar.$description: What lies over a bar under the pointer: `color` paints it.

message.$description: The text when there is nothing to draw.

tooltip-row.$description: A row of the tooltip: `active` for the value under the pointer.

tooltip-key.$description: The short line that names the series of a row.

tooltip-value.$description: The value of a row, which leads.

tooltip-name.$description: The name of the series of a row.

legend-item.$description: An item of the legend: `hover`, `focus`, and `off` when its series is hidden.

legend-key.$description: The key: `width`, `height` and `radius` for a bar or an area; a line takes the line's width.

center-value.$description: The total in the middle of a donut.

selected.$description: The ring around a chosen value: `color` paints it.

brush.$description: The band dragged across the plot to zoom: `color` paints it.
